name: Card-Not-Present and Chargeback Fraud
description: Stolen card details are used online or by phone where the physical card is not checked, and some customers or merchants abuse the chargeback system. Fraud rings test cards at low value before large purchases.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
EMVCo and card scheme guidance on 3-D Secure and chargebacks (general)

exposure.rationale: Online/phone card use, card testing, chargeback abuse.

indicators.name: Card testing with many small authorisations
indicators.canon: Card testing with many small authorisations
indicators.desc: Bursts of low-value attempts across cards, many declined, followed by a successful larger purchase.
indicators.ctx: Bursts of low-value attempts across cards, many declined, followed by a successful larger purchase.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.canon: Delivery to forwarder, mailbox or address unrelated to buyer
indicators.desc: Goods or cards are shipped to freight forwarders, reshippers, mail drops or addresses with no storage or sales operations or link to the buyer.
indicators.ctx: Goods sent to a freight forwarder or address linked to previous fraud.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)
